name: 10010 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10010 (New York) has 445 nonprofit organizations. 214 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 190 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10010 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10010 (New York) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
